factCards.text: Symphony orchestras tune to a long A played by the principal oboe, whose reed holds pitch more steadily than a string.
The ukulele developed in Hawaii after Portuguese immigrants from Madeira arrived in the late 1870s with small four-stringed instruments.
The bass tuba was patented in Berlin in 1835, making it one of the youngest members of the orchestral brass family.
